output.summary: Read SITE_PLAN.md and HOUSE_LAYOUT.md. They DIFFER: the original plan placed the house at (1.5,3)→(16.5,15) (15×12 m, 180 m²), but the house was actually built 1 m deeper at (1.5,3)→(16.5,16) (15×13 m, 195 m²) — same width and front position, rear wall at y=16 instead of y=15. Wrote FENCE_LAYOUT.md designing the fence against the ACTUAL footprint: fence on the setback lines x=1.5, x=16.5, y=22 (1.5 m inside side lot lines, 3 m inside rear lot line), path (1.5,3)→(1.5,22)→(16.5,22)→(16.5,3), total 53 m. Because of the deeper house I changed: (a) rear yard is now 6 m deep (90 m²) not 7 m; (b) side fences are attached 3→16 (13 m) and free-standing 16→22 (6 m); (c) pedestrian gates placed at y=17.0→18.0 in the free-standing side-fence portions, clear of the actual rear wall; and (d) I dropped the original plan's front fence segment (16.5,3)→(7.5,3) since the actual house facade now closes the front of the yard. No driveway gate (driveway/garage are in the front yard, outside the fenced rear yard). FENCE_LAYOUT.md written; status complete.

Read SITE_PLAN.md and designed the house. HOUSE_LAYOUT.md is written and stands on its own as the build reference. Decision: build a single-story house on footprint (1.5, 3) → (16.5, 16) = 15.0 m × 13.0 m = 195.0 m². This differs from SITE_PLAN.md's (1.5, 3) → (16.5, 15) by 1 m of depth only (same width, same front position): detailing the rooms showed the planned 12 m depth left only 4.8 m of usable rear-zone depth after the hallway, forcing the master ensuite/wardrobe into unusable sub-1.5 m slivers and leaving no room for a second bathroom, laundry or linen store. The extra 1 m gives a 6.5 m rear zone with a 1.2 m hallway plus a 5.3 m room row. Layout tiles the footprint exactly (195.0 m²): front zone — 2-car garage 39.0 m², entry foyer 7.5 m², kitchen/dining 12.0 m², living room 39.0 m²; rear zone — hallway 18.0 m², master bedroom 16.5 m² with 2.0 m-deep ensuite (5.0 m²) and walk-in wardrobe (5.0 m²), family bathroom 6.9 m², laundry 6.9 m², linen store 2.3 m², bedroom 2 (10.5 m²), bedroom 3 (10.5 m²), bedroom 4 (15.9 m²). Every bedroom reaches an external wall. Lot, setbacks, driveway (x 1.5–7.5, y 0–3) and 62 m fence are unchanged; backyard is now 15 m × 6 m = 90 m². All four required setbacks are maintained.

Wrote SITE_PLAN.md with an initial site plan. House footprint: (1.5, 3) → (16.5, 15), i.e. 15 m × 12 m (180 m²) single-story, placed at the front of the buildable envelope (buildable rectangle (1.5, 3) → (16.5, 22) = 15 m × 19 m, respecting 3 m front, 1.5 m side, 3 m rear setbacks). Internal zoning: 2-car garage (1.5,3)→(7.5,9) 6×6 m on the left with a driveway at x 1.5–7.5, y 0–3; living/entry (7.5,3)→(16.5,9); 4-bedroom wing (1.5,9)→(16.5,15). Backyard (1.5,15)→(16.5,22) = 15 m × 7 m (105 m²). Fence path on the setback lines: (1.5,3)→(1.5,22)→(16.5,22)→(16.5,3)→(7.5,3), 62 m total, with a 6 m driveway opening at the front. Reasoning and explicit coordinates documented in SITE_PLAN.md.
